drm-protected.label: DRM protected
drm-protected.hint: The file is encrypted, so nothing can copy or re-encode its streams.

video-missing.label: No video
video-missing.hint: No video stream was found in the file.

video-multiple.label: Extra video tracks
video-multiple.hint: More than one real video track; clients only ever play the first.

video-codec-unsupported.label: Video codec unsupported
video-codec-unsupported.hint: The video codec does not direct play on mainstream clients, so the server transcodes it.

video-codec-limited.label: Video codec limited
video-codec-limited.hint: The video plays on some clients but not all of them.

video-high10-profile.label: 10-bit H.264
video-high10-profile.hint: H.264 High 10 has almost no hardware decoders, so most clients transcode it.

video-level-too-high.label: H.264 level too high
video-level-too-high.hint: The stream's H.264 level is above what the configured clients accept.

video-chroma-unsupported.label: Chroma not 4:2:0
video-chroma-unsupported.hint: 4:2:2 or 4:4:4 video, which consumer decoders do not handle.

video-interlaced.label: Interlaced
video-interlaced.hint: Interlaced video, which Plex deinterlaces on every play.

video-dolby-vision-profile.label: Dolby Vision profile
video-dolby-vision-profile.hint: A Dolby Vision profile with no HDR10 fallback, so non-DV clients show the wrong colours.

video-resolution-high.label: Above height ceiling
video-resolution-high.hint: Taller than the configured height ceiling for remote streaming.

video-anamorphic.label: Anamorphic
video-anamorphic.hint: Non-square pixels; some clients show the picture stretched.

video-refframes-high.label: Many reference frames
video-refframes-high.hint: More reference frames than some hardware decoders allow.

video-hevc-wrong-tag.label: HEVC tag
video-hevc-wrong-tag.hint: HEVC tagged hev1 in an MP4; Apple clients need hvc1.

audio-codec-unsupported.label: Audio codec unsupported
audio-codec-unsupported.hint: An audio codec mainstream clients cannot decode.

audio-codec-limited.label: Audio codec limited
audio-codec-limited.hint: An audio codec only some clients decode.

audio-channels-high.label: Many audio channels
audio-channels-high.hint: More channels than many clients play without a transcode.

audio-no-compatible-track.label: No compatible audio
audio-no-compatible-track.hint: Not one audio track plays everywhere.

audio-missing.label: No audio
audio-missing.hint: The file has no audio track at all.

container-not-mp4.label: Not MP4
container-not-mp4.hint: The file is not in the target container and can be rewrapped losslessly.

container-unsupported.label: Container unsupported
container-unsupported.hint: A container Plex clients do not direct play.

container-blocked-by-stream.label: Kept as MKV
container-blocked-by-stream.hint: A stream MP4 cannot hold keeps the file in MKV.

mp4-not-faststart.label: Index at end
mp4-not-faststart.hint: The MP4 index sits at the end of the file, so remote clients stall before playback starts.

subtitle-image-based.label: Image subtitles
subtitle-image-based.hint: PGS or VobSub subtitles, which force a transcode to burn in on most clients.

subtitle-image-default.label: Image subtitles by default
subtitle-image-default.hint: An image subtitle track is the default, so it is burned in on every play.

subtitle-styled-ass.label: Styled subtitles
subtitle-styled-ass.hint: ASS/SSA styling, which many clients render by transcoding.

subtitle-unsupported-in-mp4.label: Subtitles MP4 cannot hold
subtitle-unsupported-in-mp4.hint: A subtitle format that cannot travel into MP4.

language-missing.label: Missing language
language-missing.hint: A track with no language tag.

language-nonstandard.label: Non-standard language
language-nonstandard.hint: A language tag that is not ISO 639-2.

default-audio-missing.label: No default audio
default-audio-missing.hint: No audio track is marked to play by default.

default-audio-multiple.label: Several default audio
default-audio-multiple.hint: More than one audio track is marked as the default.

default-audio-language-mismatch.label: Default audio language
default-audio-language-mismatch.hint: The default audio track is not in the preferred language.

preferred-audio-language-absent.label: No preferred-language audio
preferred-audio-language-absent.hint: No audio track is in the preferred language.

default-subtitle-multiple.label: Several default subtitles
default-subtitle-multiple.hint: More than one subtitle track is marked as the default.

default-subtitle-unwanted.label: Unwanted default subtitle
default-subtitle-unwanted.hint: A subtitle plays by default when it should not.

default-subtitle-language-mismatch.label: Default subtitle language
default-subtitle-language-mismatch.hint: The default subtitle track is not in the preferred language.

forced-subtitle-not-flagged.label: Forced subtitle unflagged
forced-subtitle-not-flagged.hint: A forced-subtitle track is not flagged as forced.

statuses.label: Passed
statuses.hint: Nothing to do — direct plays as it is (see details for any notes)

statuses.label: Fixable
statuses.hint: A lossless remux fixes this file

statuses.label: Re-encode
statuses.hint: Only a video re-encode fixes this file

statuses.label: Blocked
statuses.hint: No automatic repair fixes this — open the row for why, and what you can do
